text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Wonder Acute!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Look at all these people
cheering for little
old me. They seem to
be multiplying.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the G3 Sirius Stakes,
and it's obvious that Wonder Acute's
steady perseverance has led to an
equally steady increase in her
popularity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And among all the eyes on Wonder
Acute, one
set in particular is watching
with pronounced
intensity.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My! Do you see that person over there,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They've been staring right at me for a
while now.
Those eyes seem very kind,
yet... also sad.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Would you go talk to them for me and
make sure
everything's all right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute can't very well head into
the
stands before the race, so I go check
on the fan in
her place.

You're Wonder Acute's trainer, aren't
you?
I'm sorry, I didn't mean to stare.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A flash of metal catches my eye—a
trainer's
badge.

text_block_list.name: Retired Trainer
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am. Sorry again about before.

text_block_list.name: Retired Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I got lost in thought when I saw Wonder
Acute.

text_block_list.name: Retired Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She reminds me of an Umamusume I
used to work
with a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Retired Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I've thought so for a while now, so I've
been
following her races.

text_block_list.name: Retired Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Now, whenever I hear she's running, I
find myself
at the racecourse before I
even know it.

text_block_list.name: Retired Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that there are others who see my
old
trainee in Wonder Acute too, so I
hope she keeps
going.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, so that's what it is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute nods in understanding as
I recount
my encounter with the other
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There are all kinds of reasons people
have for
supporting me. They're not all
necessarily fans...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They might have feelings they can't or
don't want
to forget, or other feelings I
can't even imagine...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. I...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can feel this lovely warmth in my chest
right
now. It's different from the usual
fire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might not be her usual fighting
spirit... but it's
raised her spirits just the same. It seems
Umamusume have all sorts of
reasons to run.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even if the voices cheering for me are
just a whisper compared to the cheers
for Falco, they've
still touched my
heart...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do well today. I can feel it
in my
bones.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Will you watch me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll be watching her. Me and
that other
trainer both.
